blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate’s proposed budget for fiscal year 2027 was quickly approved at the Senate finance committee level on Thursday. Senate Secretary Atty. Renato Bantug presented the budget for the chamber. Bantug noted that the Senate is accepting the amount that the Department of Budget and Management allocated in the National Expenditures Program (NEP). He also added that, if need be, the Senate will be willing to shave off P2 billion from the DBM’s proposed allocation. “Our budget permutations will include, at the maximum, at a level provided for in the NEP, and as low as P2 billion less […]...
